comments.author: False_Geologist_7739
comments.body:
Congrats on getting it approved, that first "it's live" moment is the best! A few things that helped me on my own page:

* Even before the real trailer, a 30-60 s raw gameplay capture as the first video is worth it. A lot of people only watch the top video and decide in a few seconds, and stills alone convert noticeably worse.
* For co-op horror, show the co-op in the first screenshots: two players in frame, one panicking while the other laughs. That's the hook people share with their friends.
* Double-check your tags: Online Co-Op, Horror, Multiplayer and Survival Horror near the top help Steam show it to the right people.
* If you can do a demo before your release, Next Fest is huge for co-op games because people grab a friend and try it together.

Wishlisted, good luck with the launch!
